repo_meta_data.description: Web knowledge is fragmented — duplicated across fonts, embeddings, metadata, and renderings. Humans see pixels, AI sees tokens, neither shares the source. Knowledge3D: a sovereign GPU-native reference implementation for W3C PM-KR, where humans and AI consume the same procedural knowledge from one source.
